title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description: Join our Product team as a Senior Technical Business Analyst and help shape the future of global finance.<br><br>We're on a mission to build the world's leading platform for both crypto and fiat payments and we're looking for a sharp, driven Senior Technical Business Analyst to play a key role in that journey.<br><br>You'll be part of a fast-growing team, working at the intersection of payments, e-money, and crypto. If you're naturally curious, passionate about financial technology, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this is the role for you.<br><br>This is a high-impact position that calls for deep, hands-on knowledge of payment schemes and e-money wallets. You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and clients to deliver real business value every day. There's a lot to discover, and as we grow, you'll have plenty of room to grow with us.<br><br>Key Responsibilities<br><br><ul><li>Drive discussions with product manager and business subject matter experts to understand the process, the problem, and then negotiate solution scenarios</li><li>Perform cost-benefit analyses on different technology solutions</li><li>Inform business decisions through relevant data analysis</li><li>Actively engage product manager and business SMEs to translate solution needs into actionable user stories</li><li>Facilitate and support product backlog management</li><li>Partner with product manager / business SMEs to define &amp; refine acceptance criteria</li><li>Partner with developers on reviewing user stories for understanding and scoring</li><li>Draft both technical documentation and non-functional requirements that describe how systems should behave and establish their functionality constraints</li><li>Write test cases for user stories</li><li>Perform/coordinate user acceptance testing to ensure functionality meets business needs before each product release</li><li>Secure approval &amp; change management activities with product manager before release</li><li>Analyse and model business processes to identify gaps and improve IT products and services<br><br></li></ul>What are we looking for?<br><br><strong>Essential<br><br></strong><ul><li>Extensive experience of business analysis or project management experience</li><li>Experience in the blockchain industry (crypto exchange, custodian, stablecoin issuer, infrastructure provider, etc.)</li><li>Experience (or at least strong interest in) payment applications</li><li>Experience gathering and consolidating requirements from cross-functional groups</li><li>Experience of working closely with Compliance and Legal teams</li><li>Strong attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills</li><li>Excellent verbal/written communication and data presentation skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams</li><li>Exceptional process and organisational skills with the ability to mobilise change</li><li>Advanced knowledge of project/product management platforms (JIRA &amp; Confluence strongly preferred)</li><li>Advanced knowledge of common data-manipulation tools (SQL, Google Sheets)</li><li>Advanced knowledge of data analytics platforms (Looker preferred)</li><li>Experienced in both lean and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)<br><br></li></ul><strong>Desirable<br><br></strong><ul><li>IIBA-CCBA certification preferred</li><li>An understanding of current crypto regulations</li><li>Basic proficiency in at least one of the most commonly used backend programming languages (Python, Node.JS, Java, PHP, GO, C#, C++)</li><li>Some experience with testing</li><li>Familiar with version control tools and proper branching techniques (Gitlab preferred)</li><li>Experience working with data warehouses (Google Cloud BigQuery), data governance, payments and treasury or capital markets systems<br><br></li></ul><strong>So, what's in it for you?<br><br></strong>Our people are constantly striving to be the best through operational excellence. The professional development and learning opportunities create an agile, hardworking, conscientious, and knowledgeable team.<br><br>The opportunities for personal growth are exponential. You grow as the business grows. The roles and responsibilities are broad and ever-changing, and the dynamism of BCB keeps you engaged and highly motivated.<br><br>At BCB, we believe in empowering individuals to create a culture of personal growth, together, and driving empowerment from the bottom up, up-skilling every individual at every level. This means our team has a sense of commonality and belonging, driven by a shared belief in our mission. We're passionate about our business, our people, and providing 360-degree support for success.<br><br><ul><li>The chance to operate at the forefront of our industry </li><li>You can talk to anyone in the business as there are no barriers and everyone is accessible</li><li>You will be collaborating with teams on a hybrid working arrangement</li><li>We value team success where every individual can grow and prosper</li><li>30 days annual leave each year</li><li>4 wellbeing days per year to prioritise your mental health </li><li>1 company volunteering day per year</li><li>Strong benefits package including; Private Healthcare, Pension, Income Protection (long-term absence), Life Insurance, Menopause Policy, and an enhanced Parental Leave policy<br><br></li></ul><strong>About BCB GROUP<br><br></strong>BCB Group is a leading provider of regulated payment and trading services in crypto and fiat for the digital asset economy. We provide accounts, cryptocurrency and foreign exchange market liquidity for some of the world's largest, crypto-engaged businesses, including crypto exchanges, liquidity providers, market makers, investment firms, custodians, payment processors and wallet providers.<br><br>Our end-to-end suite of products are accessible through our Client Console UI and API. We offer more than 40 fiat and cryptocurrencies, deep trading liquidity, 24/7 instant payments through our instant settlements network, BLINC, and secure crypto services. Our strong focus on compliance matches our technical and business expertise, and we are regulated by some of the world's most respected regulators. Authorised in the UK, France and Switzerland, we place the utmost importance on our regulatory-first institutional principles.<br><br>Our leadership team boasts years of relevant, high-level experience at globally-renowned institutions. They combine finance, law, regulatory and technology skills in traditional and crypto financial services with a deep understanding of the new digital asset economy. Our mission is to create the trusted platform to pay, store, trade and earn fiat and digital assets, globally 24/7<br><br>www.bcbgroup.com

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: <strong>Company Overview <br><br></strong>At Leapwork, our vision is to break down the barriers between humans and computers through the world’s most accessible automation platform. We are the leading global AI-powered visual test automation solution, enabling some of the world’s largest enterprises to adopt, scale, and maintain automation – in under 30 days.<br><br>In today’s environment, where efficiency, automation, and cost optimization are essential to enterprise growth, we are uniquely positioned to deliver impact.<br><br>We're looking for a <strong>Senior Customer Success Manager</strong> who thrives at the intersection of technology, strategy, and relationships. In this role, you’ll own and grow some of our most valuable customer accounts, partnering closely with executive stakeholders to drive adoption, deliver measurable outcomes, and ensure long-term success. <br><br><strong>The Role<br><br></strong>As a Senior CSM, you’ll be the strategic advisor and customer advocate from onboarding through renewal.<br><br><strong>You Will<br><br></strong><strong>Onboard &amp; Enable <br><br></strong><ul><li>Orchestrate the onboarding process by aligning customer stakeholders, internal teams, and timelines </li><li>Collaborate with our Professional Services, Product and CX teams to ensure smooth platform setup and training delivery </li><li>Define success metrics and automation objectives collaboratively </li><li>Serve as the strategic point of contact during onboarding, ensuring business alignment and early wins <br><br></li></ul><strong>Drive Adoption &amp; Value <br><br></strong><ul><li>Build and execute adoption roadmaps tied to measurable business outcomes </li><li>Monitor usage data and proactively identify risks and growth opportunities </li><li>Continuously demonstrate ROI through reporting, value narratives, and business reviews <br><br></li></ul><strong>Manage Renewals &amp; Growth <br><br></strong><ul><li>Own the full renewal process – from forecasting and positioning to contract execution </li><li>Identify expansion opportunities and collaborate with Sales to drive upsells </li><li>Conduct high-impact Executive Business Reviews with business and technical stakeholders <br><br></li></ul><strong>Advocate &amp; Collaborate <br><br></strong><ul><li>Act as the customer’s internal champion – translating their needs to Product, Engineering, Marketing and Support </li><li>Lead cross-functional efforts to resolve challenges and deliver exceptional experiences </li><li>Collaborate with Marketing to develop customer stories, case studies, or advocacy initiatives <br><br></li></ul><strong>You Are... <br><br></strong><ul><li>Proactive: You anticipate needs and solve problems early </li><li>Empathetic: You understand and care about customer goals </li><li>Resilient: You stay focused under pressure and adapt with confidence </li><li>Curious: You dig deep, ask questions, and learn fast </li><li>Ownership-minded: You take full accountability for outcomes – not just tasks <br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Bring<br><br></strong><ul><li>5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management (or similar), </li><li>Experience managing large enterprise SaaS customers, ideally in DevOps, QA, or automation </li><li>BA/BS degree in CS or Computer Engineering-related field or equivalent experience   </li><li>Exceptional executive presence with outstanding communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging and influencing stakeholders at all levels  </li><li>Proficiency with CRM and CS tools </li><li>Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations and design effective processes   </li><li>Ability to travel occasionally for key meetings or onsite strategy sessions <br><br></li></ul><strong>Why Leapwork?</strong> <br><br>We are on an exciting journey of global growth – and this is your chance to get onboard. <br><br>By joining our team, you’ll become part of a fast-paced international environment where you can grow, challenge yourself, and do what inspires you. We work hard, but have fun while doing it – and we believe that collaboration, social activities and celebration are keys to success. <br><br><strong>Our Leapwork principles</strong> <br><br>Our five key principles capture the essence of what it means to be a part of our world-class team! They are integral to how we approach our work and one another, and they serve as a roadmap to our continued growth, development, achievements, and success. <br><br><ul><li>Customer first; We listen to our customers, understand their pain points and focus on what matters to them  </li><li>Lead from the front; Leading means guiding others towards the solutions to our challenges  </li><li>Get it done; We make commitments, follow through and deliver work we’re proud of  </li><li>Build excellence; We do our best work every day, holding ourselves and others to the highest standards  </li><li>Respectfully different; We treat each other with respect, always. We’re different, not indifferent</li></ul>
